props.caption: The portable package crosses runtimes; the subprocess boundary remains the host’s problem.

items.note: The local evacuation order preceded the first provincial emergency publication by 12 hours and 50 minutes.
A conditional $1.4 billion federal commitment reaches upstream from drones and robots into silicon-carbon anodes.
Typhoon Dolphin cut power before closing ports and fishing routes on the next coast.
SK hynix’s AI-memory buildout starts with water, power and cleanrooms scheduled years ahead.
A four-hour labour stoppage has no published tonnage or berth-delay ledger yet.

items.kicker: Astra Gets the Controls Before the Score
items.what: OpenAI says it cannot rule out its forthcoming Astra model reaching its Critical cybersecurity threshold, so it tightened tool and network access, isolated testing and paused some internal activity. The company has not published the underlying evaluation card or shown that Astra crossed the threshold; conservative controls arrived before public proof.

items.kicker: Fifty-Four Trillion Won Buys Cleanrooms Later
items.what: SK hynix approved roughly 54 trillion won for DRAM/HBM capacity at Yongin and NAND capacity at Cheongju. The first cleanrooms are scheduled for 2028 and 2029, which makes this compute territory rather than a cure for this year’s memory constraint: electricity, water and construction cadence now sit inside the AI supply forecast.

items.kicker: Brazil Adds Twenty-Four Hours to Crypto
items.what: Brazil’s central bank will allow delays of as much as 24 hours on specified transfers above $10,000 to foreign providers or self-custody wallets, plus other risk-flagged transfers. The mechanism is a fraud-review interval, not a permanent freeze; time itself becomes the control surface.

Tanzania now permits all foreign investors to buy its Treasury bills and bonds, widening access beyond regional residents and the diaspora. Eligibility removes one gate, but repatriation, liquidity, custody and currency risk still decide whether overseas capital walks through it.

Typhoon Dolphin knocked out power to more than 50,000 buildings around Okinawa while ports, ferries and fishing operations closed along China’s eastern coast. The storm temporarily redrew both the logistics map and the Taiwan Strait’s traffic-control map without resolving the jurisdiction underneath either.

items.kicker: Fox Counts the World Cup Receipt
items.what: Fox reported quarterly advertising revenue up 78%, driven primarily by the World Cup and Tubi, while its filing also recorded higher sports-rights amortization and production costs. The tournament served broadcast ads, streaming inventory and subscription acquisition at once; Fox did not disclose a standalone World Cup expense.

items.kicker: Europe Makes Provenance Part of the Pipe
items.what: Article 50 of the EU AI Act now requires specified synthetic outputs to carry machine-readable marking where technically feasible, with a limited grace period for older systems. Provenance can authenticate an origin and edit chain; it cannot determine whether an image or claim is true.

Operators, drivers and tradespeople staged four hours of industrial action at BHP’s Port Hedland iron-ore operations during enterprise-agreement talks. The stoppage is established; no public operator or port artifact had yet quantified tonnes deferred, berth delay or recovery time.

items.kicker: Camera Glasses Meet the Door Staff
items.what: Pubs, theatres and restaurants are applying existing no-filming rules to discreet camera glasses, while Australia’s privacy commissioner has begun examining surveillance wearables. The first social boundary for ambient capture is appearing as venue policy, before lawmakers settle the wider consent problem.

items.kicker: Makkah’s Machinery Appears in an Interview
items.what: Türkiye’s foreign minister described a combined political-military committee and a Saudi-based general secretariat for the Makkah pact. The account is operationally specific but remains an Anadolu interview rather than a signatory government document, so yesterday’s publication call stays open at a sharply lower p(NO)=0.12.
